summary: Cineverse Corp. filed a Form 424B5 prospectus supplement (Supplement No. 3) to its existing at-the-market (ATM) equity offering program. The filing updates the amount of Class A common stock that may be offered and sold through agents A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners and Benchmark Company LLC, setting a new aggregate offering price of $30,000,000. This follows a March 2026 SEC Staff Interpretation allowing continued use of the prior prospectus supplement despite changes in Form S-3 eligibility. Through May 29, 2026, 1,415,066 shares have been sold. The stock trades on Nasdaq under CNVS. This is a routine ATM shelf takedown update, not a special situation.
